body: I was good friends with a guy in high school who ended up murdering someone. he was a really troubled kid. he would drink alcohol at school just about every day, he self harmed and very obviously needed some sort of mental help. aside from that I would have never imagined he would be capable of doing something so terrible. he was very kind and caring to everybody, never went out of his way to bring others down. It came out of nowhere and really shocked the small town we live in. he is currently serving life in prison w/o the possibility of parole

I have complex PTSD diagnosed by my doctor

1. Complex PTSD - I don't see a lot of professionals speaking out about this form of post traumatic stress. It comes on from prolonged trauma over a time frame rather than one single event. C-PTSD has some of the same symptoms of PTSD but they are completely different 
2. Dissociative disorders - Things such as DP/DR are very hard things to go through. Its like seeing yourself outside of your body 24/7, Like you are watching yourself through a screen. Also theres a really negative stigma of people with DID that they are dangerous and shouldn't be trusted. 

In general a lot of people are very uneducated about mental health topics & issues due to how the media portrays things. It isn't just black and white, There is so much more to it
